title: The Wild Oasis - Hotel Booking Platform
description: Modern hotel booking website allowing guests to browse luxury cabins, make reservations, and manage their bookings with Google authentication.
longDescription: Comprehensive hotel booking platform built with Next.js featuring cabin browsing, reservation management, and secure authentication. Guests can view available cabins with detailed descriptions and images, select dates, book accommodations, and manage their reservations through a personalized dashboard. The platform integrates Google OAuth for seamless user authentication and provides optimistic UI updates for enhanced user experience.
